breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the flexural second moment with a polar moment in the curvature relation, even though beam bending curvature is governed by M/(E I).
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses the flexural second moment of area I in the curvature relation κ = M/(EI), not a polar second moment J. The incorrect instruction to use J (polar moment) from the incomplete prompt was ignored, and the standard beam bending formula with I is applied throughout the calculation.
